concepts.learning_objective: Recall how the father removed the tenants, the houses and the trees around the family home.
Explain the contrast between the grandmother's belief that trees are sacred and the father's actions.

topics.title: The banyan tree and its felling

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the details the poet gives of the banyan tree's size, roots and age.
Interpret the imagery of slaughter used to describe how the tree was cut down.

topics.title: The tree that grows in dreams

concepts.learning_objective: Explain the significance of the family's move from Baroda to treeless Bombay.
Analyse what the banyan tree that 'grows and seethes' in dreams symbolises.
Recall key facts about Dilip Chitre and the collection the poem comes from.
Identify the critical tone and the meaning of words such as 'scraggy', 'massacred' and 'raw mythology'.
